raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

An EAGLE draft inherits the target's attention backend unless `--speculative-draft-attention-backend` is set. On XPU the recommended target backend is `intel_xpu`, whose paged prefill and decode kernels only accept head sizes 64, 96, 128, 192, 256 and 512.

A draft with any other head size fails on its first draft forward with `Unsupported head size for paged prefill attention`. For example, `AngelSlim/Qwen3-32B_eagle3` has head_dim 80. Users currently have to know to pass `--speculative-draft-attention-backend triton`.

## Modifications

- `arg_groups/speculative_hook.py`: new `_fall_back_xpu_draft_attention_for_head_size`, run from `_handle_eagle_family`. It applies only when all of these hold:
  - the platform is XPU,
  - no draft backend was given,
  - a draft model path is set,
  - the resolved target prefill backend is `intel_xpu`.
- When it applies, it reads the draft's HF text config (`get_hf_text_config`, so composite configs such as `Qwen3_5Config` work). The head size is `head_dim`, or `hidden_size // num_attention_heads` when the config has no `head_dim`. If that size is not one the paged kernels accept, it declares `speculative_draft_attention_backend="triton"` and logs this.
- An explicit `--speculative-draft-attention-backend` is never overridden.
- The supported-size list mirrors `src/sycl/flash_attention.cpp` in sgl-kernel-xpu. It is the same in 0.4.0 and in 0.5.0, the version pinned now. sgl-kernel-xpu main has since added paged head_dim 80 (sgl-project/sgl-kernel-xpu#565). The list should gain 80 when sglang moves to a release with that change.
- New CPU unit test `test/registered/unit/spec/test_xpu_eagle_draft_attention.py`, covering:
  - head_dim 80 resolves to triton,
  - a draft config without `head_dim` (size derived as 80) resolves to triton,
  - a composite `Qwen3_5Config` draft is read from its `text_config`, for both an unsupported and a supported head size,
  - a supported head size and an explicit draft backend are left untouched.
- Each of these mutations fails at least one case: dropping the head-size check, dropping the explicit-backend check, or making the function a no-op (the pre-fix behavior).

The RoPE crash for the same draft is fixed separately in "[Fix] [XPU] rope: Fall back to native RoPE for head sizes the XPU kernel lacks". That fix is #46997; the two PRs touch different files. Serving `AngelSlim/Qwen3-32B_eagle3` on XPU needs both.

## Accuracy Tests

- The new unit test passes (4 cases), and `test_oot_eagle_hooks.py` still passes (11 cases).
- Drafts whose head size intel_xpu supports, such as Qwen3-30B-A3B's EAGLE3 drafts, resolve exactly as before.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

With both fixes, Qwen3-32B + `AngelSlim/Qwen3-32B_eagle3` starts with no manual flag and reaches 42.4 tok/s at c=1, against 31.5 tok/s without speculative decoding.
- Setup: 4x Arc Pro B70, TP4.
- Workload: ShareGPT prompts, 256 output tokens, greedy.
- Server flags: cookbook BMG flags plus `--attention-backend intel_xpu --page-size 64 --cuda-graph-backend-decode full --cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable --speculative-algorithm EAGLE3 --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4`.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@AgainstEntropy — review from @airMeng: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47956#discussion_r4445821182

**[P1] Extract the draft text config before reading attention dimensions**

`get_config()` returns the full Hugging Face config, but composite draft configs such as `Qwen3_5Config` store `head_dim`, `hidden_size`, and `num_attention_heads` under `text_config`. With XPU, inherited `intel_xpu` attention, and no explicit draft attention backend, this new check raises before draft initialization—even when the actual text head dimension is supported.

I reproduced this using a locally saved `Qwen3_5Config` and the real `get_config()` loader: the text head dimension is 256, but this expression raises `AttributeError: 'Qwen3_5Config' object has no attribute 'hidden_size'`.

Please extract the text config with `get_hf_text_config()` before calculating the head dimension, and add a composite-config regression test. The current tests only cover flat configs.

@@ -1110,6 +1110,50 @@ def _check_oot_speculative_algorithm(algorithm: str, device: str) -> None:
         )
 
 
+# Head sizes the paged prefill/decode kernels behind intel_xpu accept (sgl-kernel-xpu
+# src/sycl/flash_attention.cpp); any other head size raises on the first draft forward.
+_INTEL_XPU_PAGED_ATTENTION_HEAD_SIZES = (64, 96, 128, 192, 256, 512)
+
+
+def _fall_back_xpu_draft_attention_for_head_size(server_args: ServerArgs) -> None:
+    """Give an EAGLE draft the triton backend when intel_xpu cannot run its head size."""
+    cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
+    if (
+        not get_platform().is_xpu
+        or cfg.speculative_draft_attention_backend is not None
+        or cfg.speculative_draft_model_path is None
+        or attention_backends_of(resolved_view(server_args))[0] != "intel_xpu"
+    ):
+        return
+    from sglang.srt.utils.hf_transformers.common import get_hf_text_config
+    from sglang.srt.utils.hf_transformers.config import get_config
+
+    # Composite configs (e.g. Qwen3_5Config) keep the attention dims in a text sub-config.
+    draft_hf_config = get_hf_text_config(
+        get_config(
+            cfg.speculative_draft_model_path,
+            trust_remote_code=cfg.trust_remote_code,
+            revision=cfg.speculative_draft_model_revision,
+        )
+    )
+    # head_dim is optional in HF configs; without it the head size is hidden / heads.
+    head_dim = getattr(draft_hf_config, "head_dim", None) or (
+        draft_hf_config.hidden_size // draft_hf_config.num_attention_heads
+    )
+    if head_dim in _INTEL_XPU_PAGED_ATTENTION_HEAD_SIZES:
+        return
+    logger.info(
+        "intel_xpu attention does not support the draft model's head size %d; "
+        "using --speculative-draft-attention-backend triton for the draft.",
+        head_dim,
+    )
+    declare_resolution(
+        server_args,
+        "_handle_eagle_family",
+        speculative_draft_attention_backend="triton",
+    )
+
+
 def _handle_eagle_family(server_args: ServerArgs) -> None:
     cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
     _check_oot_speculative_algorithm(
@@ -1197,6 +1241,7 @@ def _handle_eagle_family(server_args: ServerArgs) -> None:
                 )
 
     _handle_iquest_q1_mtp_draft(server_args)
+    _fall_back_xpu_draft_attention_for_head_size(server_args)
     if not cfg.speculative_adaptive and cfg.speculative_num_steps is None:
         assert (
             cfg.speculative_eagle_topk is None

@@ -0,0 +1,76 @@
+"""EAGLE draft attention on XPU when intel_xpu lacks the draft's head size.
+
+intel_xpu's paged kernels raise on head sizes outside 64/96/128/192/256/512, so a
+draft that inherits it (e.g. head_dim 80) must resolve to triton instead.
+"""
+
+import sys
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+from transformers import PretrainedConfig, Qwen3_5Config
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import resolution_result
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.speculative_hook import (
+    _fall_back_xpu_draft_attention_for_head_size,
+)
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import override_platform
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _resolve(draft_config: PretrainedConfig, **overrides):
+    args = ServerArgs(
+        model_path="dummy",
+        device="xpu",
+        attention_backend="intel_xpu",
+        speculative_algorithm="EAGLE3",
+        speculative_draft_model_path="draft",
+        **overrides,
+    )
+    with (
+        override_platform(is_xpu=True),
+        patch(
+            "sglang.srt.utils.hf_transformers.config.get_config",
+            return_value=draft_config,
+        ),
+    ):
+        _fall_back_xpu_draft_attention_for_head_size(args)
+    return resolution_result(args, "speculative_draft_attention_backend")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "draft_config",
+    [
+        PretrainedConfig(head_dim=80, hidden_size=5120, num_attention_heads=64),
+        # No head_dim in the config: the head size is hidden_size / heads.
+        PretrainedConfig(hidden_size=2560, num_attention_heads=32),
+    ],
+)
+def test_unsupported_draft_head_size_falls_back_to_triton(draft_config):
+    assert _resolve(draft_config) == "triton"
+
+
+def test_composite_draft_config_reads_the_text_config():
+    # Qwen3_5Config has no top-level attention dims; they live in its text_config.
+    unsupported = Qwen3_5Config(
+        text_config={"head_dim": 80, "hidden_size": 5120, "num_attention_heads": 64}
+    )
+    assert _resolve(unsupported) == "triton"
+    assert _resolve(Qwen3_5Config(text_config={"head_dim": 256})) is None
+
+
+def test_supported_or_explicit_draft_backend_is_kept():
+    supported = PretrainedConfig(head_dim=128, hidden_size=5120, num_attention_heads=64)
+    assert _resolve(supported) is None
+    unsupported = PretrainedConfig(
+        head_dim=80, hidden_size=5120, num_attention_heads=64
+    )
+    explicit = _resolve(unsupported, speculative_draft_attention_backend="intel_xpu")
+    assert explicit == "intel_xpu"
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
